product: DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813) now available as a Databricks-hosted model
tagline: Model Serving now supports DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813) as a Databricks hosted model in the us west 2 region.
what_it_does: Model Serving now supports DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813) as a Databricks hosted model in the us west 2 region. This large mixture of experts language model supports reasoning and function calling for complex coding and agentic workflows. You can access this model using Foundation Model APIs.
why_it_matters: For production workloads, Databricks recommends priority pay per token, also referred to as priority mode, for latency sensitive workloads that need more consistent performance under load.
plain_summary: Model Serving now supports DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813) as a Databricks hosted model in the us west 2 region. This large mixture of experts language model supports reasoning and function calling for complex coding and agentic workflows.
